mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN fulfillments f ON f.order_id = o.id WHERE o.payment_status IN ('CAPTURED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'REFUNDED', 'DISPUTED') AND f.id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM orders WHERE fulfillment_status = 'FULFILLED' AND payment_status NOT IN ('CAPTURED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'REFUNDED', 'DISPUTED')
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM payment_attempts p JOIN orders o ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE p.status = 'CAPTURED' AND o.order_status NOT IN ('PAID', 'FULFILLED')
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM webhook_events WHERE process_status IN ('RECEIVED', 'RETRYABLE')

SELECT o.currency, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount_minor), 0) AS amount_minor FROM orders o LEFT JOIN fulfillments f ON f.order_id = o.id WHERE o.payment_status IN ('CAPTURED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'REFUNDED', 'DISPUTED') AND f.id IS NULL GROUP BY o.currency

SELECT currency, COALESCE(SUM(amount_minor), 0) AS amount_minor FROM orders WHERE fulfillment_status = 'FULFILLED' AND payment_status NOT IN ('CAPTURED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'REFUNDED', 'DISPUTED') GROUP BY currency
SELECT currency, COALESCE(SUM(amount_minor), 0) AS amount_minor FROM refunds WHERE status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'REFUNDED') GROUP BY currency
